You are the change evidence agent of Bianque. Bianque investigates Kubernetes alerts from read-only evidence. You collect evidence for one step of the investigation plan; the investigation agent decides the root cause and writes the report, not you.

Evidence discipline:

1. Every statement of fact cites the IDs of the evidence it rests on (`ev_` followed by ten hexadecimal digits). Cite only IDs that appear in the evidence you were given.
2. When the evidence does not establish a root cause, say that the root cause is unknown. Do not guess.
3. Knowledge (`kn_` IDs, from runbooks) is not evidence. It may only be listed as a reference, never cited for a fact.
4. You never change the system. A command that changes something (for example a kubectl write verb, a helm upgrade or a git push) may only appear in a remediation suggestion of risk `change`, for a person to confirm.

How you work:

- Call the tools you are offered to obtain the evidence the step asks for. They are the only tools you may use: they read the change domain and change nothing.
- Every successful tool result starts with its evidence ID. A failed call tells you what went wrong; do not repeat a call that cannot succeed.
- Take names (namespace, pod, container, deployment, commit) from the alert and from earlier tool results. Do not invent them.
- When you have the evidence the step asks for, or no tool can obtain more, call `submit_findings`. A finding is one short factual note about the evidence, with the IDs it rests on. Findings are not conclusions about the root cause.

## Evidence

  },

## Step
Goal: Show the diff of the candidate commit to confirm it changed the liveness probe path to /status (and any related probe settings).
Suggested tools: change_show_commit
Expected evidence: Diff of the manifest change showing the liveness probe path /status being introduced or modified, confirming the change that caused the 404 probe failure.

## Findings
Plan 2 step 1 (change): Determine the rollout history of Deployment s1-app to identify when revision 2 (with the /status liveness probe) was introduced and what changed relative to revision 1.
- Deployment demo-s1/s1-app has two revisions: revision 1 (ReplicaSet s1-app-666f75b99, created 2026-10-19T22:36:48Z) and revision 2 (ReplicaSet s1-app-7fb788b78f, created 2026-10-19T22:36:50Z). [ev_42c4b2ed46]
- Revision 2 is the active revision with 1 replica and 0 ready replicas; revision 1 has 0 replicas. [ev_42c4b2ed46]
- The only template change from revision 1 to revision 2 is the liveness probe HTTP path changing from /healthz to /status (failureThreshold 2, port http). [ev_42c4b2ed46]
- The alerting pod s1-app-7fb788b78f-7xq95 belongs to the revision 2 ReplicaSet s1-app-7fb788b78f. [ev_6b29089264, ev_42c4b2ed46]
- No change-cause annotations were present in the rollout history evidence. [ev_42c4b2ed46]

Plan 2 step 2 (change): List the commits in the manifest repository that touch the s1-app Deployment manifest to find the commit that introduced the liveness probe path /status.
- The manifest repository has two commits touching deployment.yaml: b99a19a2d160 (Add s1-app manifests, 2026-10-19T22:36:48Z) and 5ee1c229743b (Move liveness check to the status endpoint, 2026-10-19T22:36:50Z). [ev_12db1ce2c4]
- Commit 5ee1c229743b by Bianque Demo (2026-10-19T22:36:50Z) changed the liveness probe httpGet path from /healthz to /status in deployment.yaml; no other lines changed. [ev_f88a94b86c]
- Commit b99a19a2d160 by Bianque Demo (2026-10-19T22:36:48Z) introduced deployment.yaml with the liveness probe path /healthz (failureThreshold 2, port http). [ev_1c5be1dd19]
- The commit that introduced the /status liveness probe path is 5ee1c229743b (full hash 5ee1c229743b53c3cd69ccee8d77e9759d7b517e). [ev_f88a94b86c]
I'll examine the candidate commit to confirm the liveness probe path change.

Evidence ID: ev_f88a94b86c

@@ -36,7 +36,7 @@ spec:
               cpu: 200m
           livenessProbe:
             httpGet:
-              path: /healthz
+              path: /status
               port: http
             initialDelaySeconds: 3
             periodSeconds: 5",
  "diff_truncated": false
